selection: Traced LC10a, AOTU019, AOTU025, DNa02; only named two-hop bridges

structural_path_probe.definition: Each stimulated-side LC10a supplies one abstract unit. For each two-edge path, multiply its two synapse counts and the AOTU transmitter sign (ACh +1, GABA -1), then sum by DNa02 side. No currents, spikes, timing, receptors, sensory tuning, or motor commands are modeled.

controls.bridge_removed: Set all selected AOTU-to-DNa02 edges to zero.
controls.bridge_side_swapped: Retain every selected edge weight and sign, but send each AOTU-to-DNa02 edge to the opposite DNa02 side.
